userAuthorizationTextExact: 采用上述简化方案再恢复实现

resolvedMethodDecision.scientificEndpointUnchanged: owner-thread cumulative managed allocation bytes from the exact GC.Alloc marker during an explicit native measurement window
resolvedMethodDecision.abiAmendment: Require the Unity 2022.3.30f1c1-observed Begin-event allocation-size payload as UInt32 with four bytes and a non-null pointer, then losslessly widen each positive value to a checked 64-bit cumulative counter.
resolvedMethodDecision.gcControlCorrection: Counters must never decrease. Whenever event count is unchanged, bytes must remain exactly unchanged; whenever event count increases, bytes must increase consistently. Forced collection is not required to be allocation-free.
simplifiedActiveChain: one versioned Windows x86-64 production plugin
one algorithm-free known-answer harness that writes one terminal PASS/FAIL receipt containing all completed stages and raw records collected before failure
resolvedMethodDecision.reusedRecord: The 1 MiB known-array record is reused for same-thread positivity and the byte/rate formula; no separate rate-payload window is run.
